desc: Fires off a Wand attack at an enemy and deals an additional Arcane damage. This spell is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead and Demons. Generates 1 Echo Fragment.

name: Warpstriker
desc: Reduces the cost of your spells by % and the chance for your spells to be dispelled by %.

name: Waves of Time
desc: Blast enemies in a frontal cone with time fractals, knocking them back slightly. The knockback repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec.

name: Wisdom
desc: Increases Spirit by %.

name: Wonders of Time
desc: Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by %. Does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, all healing done now has a % chance to grant you Endless Sands.

name: Wound Removal
desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Reverse Wound by %.
